tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Antimicrobial activity of PZJ5 against indicator strains.
footnotes: ATCC, American Type Culture Collection, Rockville, MD; CGMCC, China General Microbiological Culture Collection Center, Peking, China.
MIC was determined by the agar-well diffusion method [18].
MRS medium was used instead of LB medium.
YPD medium was used instead of LB medium.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Oligonucleotide primers used to obtain the PZJ5 gene structure.
footnotes: In the degenerate primers, N, R, Y, and D indicate A/T/G/C, A/G, T/C, and A/T/G, respectively.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Summary of purification index of plantaricin ZJ5 produced by L. Plantarum ZJ5.
footnotes: The specific activity is the ratio between the total activity and total protein

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Peptidase sensitivity of plantaricin ZJ5.
footnotes: Enzyme treatments were performed at 37°C for 2 h, and Escherichia coli was used as the indicator strain. Diameters were based on the clear zones of inhibition.
